description: A mod for Minecraft which allows to instantly mine veins of ore

mods.name: Serverside VeinMiner Mod
mods.description: Server-side Vein Miner.  Allows one to instantly mine ore veins on a server, without having the mod installed.

releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* fix: Commands wont be suggested due to client-sided NPE by @hamusuke0323 in https://github.com/Tourmi/mc-server-side-vein-miner/pull/28
* Create initial build script by @Tourmi in https://github.com/Tourmi/mc-server-side-vein-miner/pull/31
* Create createRelease.yml #30 by @Tourmi in https://github.com/Tourmi/mc-server-side-vein-miner/pull/32
* Update updateBranchFromMain.yml by @Tourmi in https://github.com/Tourmi/mc-server-side-vein-miner/pull/34
* Fix #36 crash due to reobf option by @Tourmi in https://github.com/Tourmi/mc-server-side-vein-miner/pull/37
* Cleaned up config and commands, moved client configs and fixed warnings by @Tourmi in https://github.com/Tourmi/mc-server-side-vein-miner/pull/41
* The trigger condition for the mod can now be configured by users by @Tourmi in https://github.com/Tourmi/mc-server-side-vein-miner/pull/42
* Fix client config trigger_when not saving by @Tourmi in https://github.com/Tourmi/mc-server-side-vein-miner/pull/43
* Update to latest forge version by @Vespertine112 in https://github.com/Tourmi/mc-server-side-vein-miner/pull/57
* #48 - Reset player states on logout by @Tourmi in https://github.com/Tourmi/mc-server-side-vein-miner/pull/65
* Fix #66 post-merge build issues by @Tourmi in https://github.com/Tourmi/mc-server-side-vein-miner/pull/67
* Set maximum minecraft to 1.21.5 and forge version to 55 by @Tourmi in https://github.com/Tourmi/mc-server-side-vein-miner/pull/68
* Create ModUtils utility class for version isolation by @Tourmi in https://github.com/Tourmi/mc-server-side-vein-miner/pull/69
* Setup project for version 1.21.6 by @Tourmi in https://github.com/Tourmi/mc-server-side-vein-miner/pull/70

## New Contributors
* @hamusuke0323 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Tourmi/mc-server-side-vein-miner/pull/28
* @Vespertine112 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Tourmi/mc-server-side-vein-miner/pull/57

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Tourmi/mc-server-side-vein-miner/compare/1.19.2-1.2.4.0...1.21.6-2.0.0.2
